results.title: At least 7 killed in Boko Haram attack in Cameroon | News.az
results.snippet:
Source: AFP

At least seven people, including four civilians and three militants, have been killed when Boko Haram fighters raided a locality in Cameroon's Far North region, security sources said Thursday.

The attack occurred overnight into Thursday in Koza in the Mayo-Tsanaga division, Xinhua reported.
